svg.title: v84 final system architecture
svg.desc: Inputs and features feed tree, neural and Rome-mode base learners. Their saved predictions form 48 historical version vectors and four direct public-input mixtures. A fixed v80 assembly chain (v71 to v79) combines them with public EUROCONTROL aggregates; v84 adds the TabM and robust other-runway corrections and is delivered as unique-rose_final.parquet with an offline replay bundle.
